newsitem.title: USA: Bentley to buy drug rights from Schwarz.
newsitem.headline: Bentley to buy drug rights from Schwarz.

text.p: Bentley Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Wednesday that it has agreed to buy the domestic and international rights to a portfolio of branded drugs from Schwarz Pharma AG's Schwarz Pharma Inc.

The terms of the agreement were not disclosed; however Bentley said in a statement that a letter of intent dated July 21 will serve as the basis for negotiations for the definitive agreement, which required the immediate payment of a non-refundable deposit by Bentley.
The arrangement also includes a plan for Bentley to manufacture seven Schwarz prescription and over-the-counter products with terms ranging from one year to 10 years.

James Murphy, chairman and CEO of Bentley, said, "Through this acquisition, we hope to fulfill part of our previously announced business strategy to establish a commercial presence in the U.S. and grow through the continuous acquisition of portfolios of products which will provide immediate shareholder value."

Murphy added, "Bentley has other negotiations underway consistent with its strategy to acquire high-margin, branded products that can be synergistically promoted with this gastrointestinal product line."

Bentley Pharmacutical, formerly Belmac Corp, has several products under development, including Biolid antibiotic, Azaquinone anti-mycobacterial for tuberculosis and micobacterium avium complex for AIDS patients.
Schwarz Pharma is the U.S. subsidiary of Schwarz Pharma AG a German pharmaceutical company.
